sentences.en: Suppose the year pillar is taken as the root: if it carries the Officer star and the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬 yìnshòu), then one holds office in early years, an office deriving from the ancestors.
sentences.enNote: 印綬 (seal-ribbon Resource) = the Resource (印) star; 官星 = the Officer star, cf. 正官 zhèngguān Direct Officer.

sentences.en: The month pillar is the guiding cord (提纲); if it carries the Officer star and the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬 yìnshòu), then one is magnanimous and clever, with insight surpassing others.
sentences.enNote: 提纲 lit. 'the head-rope of a net,' i.e. the governing principle of the chart.

sentences.en: For instance, when Jiǎ or Yǐ (yang/yin Wood) meets a Yín or Mǎo luck-period, this is called Rob Wealth and Wealth-Wrecking (劫财败财): it signifies harm (克 kè, 'overcoming') to father and mother and to the wife, loss of wealth, and quarrels; passing through a Bǐng/Dīng or Sì/Wǔ period, called Hurting Officer (伤官 shāngguān), it signifies harm to children, lawsuits, and imprisonment; Gēng/Xīn and Shēn/Yǒu, the land of the Seven Killings and Officer, signify gaining renown, but if the rise is excessive, then calamity, sickness, and grave disease; moving through a Rén/Guǐ or Hài/Zǐ period of the Generating Breath (生气 shēngqì) and the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬), it signifies auspicious blessings and growing wealth; Chén/Xū/Chǒu/Wèi and Wù/Jǐ, the Wealth period, signify that both name and profit flow freely.
sentences.enNote: For a Wood Day Master: Wood peers = 劫财 Rob Wealth; Fire offspring-phase = 伤官; Metal = 七杀/官; Water = 生气/印 (Resource that generates Wood); Earth = Wealth.

sentences.en: For instance, if the day-stem (the Day Master) is weak, one shrinks back, timid and easily shamed; if the day-stem is strong, one is boastful and extravagant, clinging stubbornly to a single view and full of self-conceit.
When the Hurting Officer (伤官 shāngguān) meets the Officer, calamity springs up in a hundred forms.

If the year pillar carries the Hurting Officer (伤官), the parents are not both intact; if the month pillar carries it, the siblings are not complete; if the day pillar carries it, wife and concubine are not complete; if the hour pillar carries it, there is no offspring to carry on the line.

The Verse Formula (《诗诀》 Shījué): for the Fire-Master with Earth as Hurting Officer, the Officer should be exhausted entirely; for the Metal-Master with Water as Hurting Officer, one must see the Officer; for the Wood-Master with Fire, when the Officer appears it must be flourishing; for the Earth-Master with Metal, once the Officer is removed it instead forms a proper Officer pattern; only for the Water-Master with Wood as Hurting Officer must both Wealth and Officer appear together for it to be a joy.
sentences.enNote: 《诗诀》 is a rhymed mnemonic ('Verse Formula'), not a book title. Each clause names a phase-pairing of Day Master and its Hurting Officer (伤官).

sentences.en: One whose chart carries this [the Eating God] is marked by ample wealth and abundant food, a broad and generous capacity, a stout large frame, leisured contentment, offspring, and long life.

It always dislikes seeing the Officer star, and shuns the Overturned Food (倒食 dàoshí, i.e. the Indirect Resource that devours the Eating God), for fear of harming its Eating God (食神); it favors the Wealth spirit generating it (相生 xiāngshēng).
sentences.enNote: 倒食 'overturned/inverted food' = the function of 偏印 Indirect Resource seizing the 食神 Eating God.

sentences.en: If only a single one appears, one is a person of good fortune; yet in the end the pattern is still not pure.
It does, however, favor a strong Day Master (身旺), and dislikes the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬), likewise for fear that it would harm the Eating God (食神).

The Verse Formula (《诗诀》 Shījué): when the Eating God has vigor it surpasses Wealth and Officer, but first the root stem [the Day Master] must be strong and flourishing; if the 'reverse harm' (反伤, i.e. the Overturned Food) comes to snatch the food, then there is ceaseless toil and hardship and a thousand kinds of misfortune.
sentences.enNote: 反伤 = 倒食/枭神, the Indirect Resource that snatches the Eating God (食神). 本干 = the Day Master.

sentences.en: When a person's wife and her wealth (女貲财) serve me, my spirit must be sound and strong before I can enjoy them; but if my own self is withered, timid, and unrousable, then though the wife's wealth be abundant, I can only gaze at it with the eyes and in the end cannot take up even a hair's worth of use from it.
sentences.enNote: 女貲财 (貲=资): the wife-and-wealth that the Direct Wealth 正财 represents; 精神康强 stands for a strong Day Master.

sentences.en: It is further said that the Direct Wealth (正财 zhèngcái) favors a strong Day Master and the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬), while it shuns the Officer star, the Overturned Food (倒食), a weak Day Master, and the Companion (比肩) and Rob Wealth (劫财).
It should not see the Officer star, for fear of it stealing away the wealth's breath (气); it favors the seal-ribbon Resource because that can generate the self when the Day Master is weak.
For instance, a Jiǎ (yang Wood) day-stem takes Jǐ (yin Earth) as its Direct Wealth (正财); if the Day Master is weak, its disaster arrives at once.
sentences.enNote: Jiǎ Wood overcomes Jǐ Earth, so Earth is its Wealth.

sentences.en: On the whole, Wealth—whether Indirect (偏) or Direct (正)—always favors the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬), and one is bound to flourish in fortune.
Dīng (yin Fire) takes Rén (yang Water) as its Officer and Gēng Metal as its Wealth, the Metal generating the Rén Officer; when the self enters a flourishing land, one is sure to flourish in fortune.
sentences.enNote: Water overcomes Fire → Rén Water is Dīng's Officer; Fire overcomes Metal → Metal is Wealth; Metal generates Water.

sentences.en: Whenever Wealth is taken as the governing pattern, it is best that the Officer star not appear.

The Indirect Wealth (偏财 piāncái), however, is the wealth of the many; one fears only that brothers and sisters [the peer stars] may snatch it away, whereupon the fortune is not whole; and if an Officer star is present, calamities issue forth by the hundred.
sentences.enNote: 兄弟姊妹 = the peer stars 比肩/劫财 that contend for shared wealth. NOTE: orig reads 若有官星 ('if an Officer star IS present'), rendered faithfully; but this contradicts ch08 i15 (an Officer star makes a GOOD chart) and standard doctrine, in which the Officer controls the robber-peers and protects Indirect Wealth. The source is very likely a corruption of 若无官星 ('if NO Officer star'). Orig left unchanged and translation kept faithful; flagged for human verification of the 有/无 character.

sentences.en: Therefore it is said: the Indirect Wealth likes to come forth and yet does not fear lying hidden; it dreads only that something should divide and seize it, turning it instead into the void (空亡 kōngwáng); if even one of these conditions is present, the office will not be formed and the wealth will not remain.
sentences.enNote: 空亡 = 旬空, the empty/voided branches; 出 = exposed in the stems, 藏 = hidden in the branches.

sentences.en: The Indirect Wealth signifies a person who is generous and not much given to hoarding money; only, once it holds its ground its effect does not stop there.
sentences.enNote: 得地不止 is terse; read with the next line as 'when the wealth star is well-placed, its influence extends beyond wealth (it also generates the Officer).'

sentences.en: For when wealth flourishes it naturally generates the Officer; but as a person such a one is affectionate yet given to cunning.
sentences.enNote: 财生官: the productive cycle 相生 in which Wealth engenders the Officer.

sentences.en: For wealth can benefit oneself and can also invite slander; when the luck-cycle runs into a flourishing and supporting state (旺相), both fortune and rank arrive together.
sentences.enNote: 旺相 = the 'thriving/supported' phase-strength states; 禄 = rank/emolument.

sentences.en: If the Four Pillars (四柱) of the chart originally carry an Officer star, it is to be read as a good chart; but if brothers [the peer stars] come forth in numbers throughout the Four Pillars, then even on entering the land of the Officer, the rise of rank is bound to be slim!
sentences.enNote: 兄弟 = the peer stars 比肩/劫财; 发禄 = the emergence of rank/emolument.

sentences.en: It is also said that obtaining it in the month-command (月令 yuèlìng) is the proper case; it favors a strong Day Master and the seal-ribbon Resource (印綬).

For instance, Jiǎ takes Xīn as its Officer and favors Earth generating that Officer; it most fears Punishment, Clash, Break, and Harm (刑冲破害), the Goat-Blade (阳刃 yángrèn), and the Seven Killings (七杀 qīshā), which make for a poor chart; and if the hour-stem meets the Killings, this is the Officer and Killings mixed together (官杀混杂).
sentences.enNote: Xīn (yin Metal) overcomes Jiǎ Wood → Xīn is the Direct Officer; Earth (Wood's Wealth) generates Metal. 阳刃 is the variant writing of 羊刃 the Goat-Blade. 刑冲破害 = 三刑/六冲/破/六害.

sentences.en: On the whole, the Officer star must obtain the seal-ribbon Resource, and with a strong Day Master it then rises; if there is no Hurting Officer (伤官) to break the Resource, and the Day Master is not weak, then it is a noble chart.

The Verse Formula (《诗诀》 Shījué): the Direct Officer (正官 zhèngguān) is benevolent and virtuous, pure in disposition, and through the literary academy and fine composition one may make one's standing in the world; when Officer and Resource generate each other (官印相生) and meet a [favorable] year and luck-cycle, one sits among the court ministers of the Jade Hall and the Golden Horse Gate.
sentences.enNote: 词馆 = the imperial literary academy (Hanlin); 玉堂 (Jade Hall) and 金马 (Golden Horse Gate) are metonyms for high court/literary office, not the almanac star 玉堂. 逢岁运 = when the annual/decade luck period is encountered; '[favorable]' is bracketed as an editorial inference (岁运 is neutral in the orig).

sentences.en: When the Day Master is strong and [the star] has vigor, it is the Indirect Officer (偏官 piānguān); when the Day Master is weak and [the star] goes unchecked, it is the Seven Killings (七杀 qīshā).
sentences.enNote: 偏官 and 七杀 are the same star; the label differs by whether the Day Master can command it.

sentences.en: For example, 甲 Jiǎ (yang Wood) takes 庚 Gēng (yang Metal) as its Seven Killings (七杀 qīshā), and it delights in 丙 Bǐng (yang Fire) and 丁 Dīng (yin Fire) to restrain it; when 乙 Yǐ (yin Wood) combines with it, this is called 'coveting the union, it forgets to kill' (贪合忘杀 tān hé wàng shā).

If the original chart among the Four Pillars (四柱) already contains something to restrain [the Killings], it welcomes entering a Seven Killings (七杀) luck-period; if the original chart has nothing to restrain it, then when the Seven Killings emerges [in the luck cycle] it becomes a calamity.

For instance, if the chart travels into a region where the Day Master is strong (身旺) and moreover has the Goat-Blade (阳刃 yángrèn), its nobility is beyond words; but it dislikes Wealth flourishing, because Wealth is able to generate the Killings.
sentences.enNote: 阳刃: the glossary's single-source rendering of this star is the Goat-Blade (羊刃 yángrèn); the text writes it 阳刃 (羊/阳 are homophones), the same star, throughout this chapter.

sentences.en: That which generates me is the Resource (印綬 yìnshòu, the seal-and-ribbon of office). The classic states: 'To have the Officer but no Resource is not a true Officer; to have the Resource but no Officer, on the contrary, forms one's good fortune.'
sentences.enNote: 印綬 is not a glossary key; rendered 'Resource' per the site convention that 印 = Resource. 官 here = the Officer (正官).

sentences.en: In general, when in life one obtains things that assist, generate (相生), and nourish [the self], so that I receive the ready-made bounty of the myriad things — is this not excellent? Therefore such a person is mostly rich in wisdom and forethought, and withal prosperous and abundant.
For the Resource (印綬) dreads Wealth; [when Wealth prevails] the person 'ties shut the mouth of the bag' (括囊 kuònáng) — that is, stays reticent and self-guarded.
sentences.enNote: 括囊 alludes to the Kūn hexagram of the 《周易》 *Zhōuyì* (Book of Changes): 'Tie up the bag — no blame, no praise,' i.e., prudent withdrawal.

sentences.en: Thus when the Four Pillars (四柱), and the course of the luck-cycle, reach the Officer's honor, this on the contrary forms one's good fortune, for the Officer-and-Killings (官鬼 guānguǐ) can generate me; one only dreads its Wealth, since Wealth can turn back and injure me.
sentences.enNote: 官鬼 here = 官杀, the Officer and the Seven Killings taken together (both overcome the self and so generate the Resource).

sentences.en: It delights in the Officer star generating the Resource (印綬), and dislikes Wealth flourishing and breaking the Resource.

For example, a 甲 (Jiǎ) person born in the 亥 Hài (Pig) or 子 Zǐ (Rat) month has Water as the Resource; it dislikes Fire harming the Officer, dislikes Earth breaking the Resource, needs to travel into a land of Birth and flourishing (生旺), and fears traveling into ground of Death (死) and Extinction (绝); if it does travel into ground of Death and Extinction, or if something else injures it, then it is imperiled!
sentences.enNote: 忌火伤官: Fire is Jiǎ's Output (the Hurting Officer, 伤官) and overcomes the Officer-star Metal. 生旺 = Birth (长生) + Prime (帝旺); 死绝 = Death + Extinction of the Twelve Life-Stages.

sentences.en: A person of the Resource (印綬) has wisdom and forethought, few illnesses throughout life, can eat their fill in abundance, and enjoys ready-made wealth and emolument; if two or three charts are set side by side, one should choose the one with the most Resource.
As a rule, having it appear on the Month and Hour pillars is excellent; and on the Month pillar it is the most crucial.
If a chart carries the Resource (印綬), it should also carry the Officer star; this is called 'Officer and Resource both complete' (官印两全 guān yìn liǎng quán), and it is surely a chart of nobility.

If the Officer star, though already present, obtains the strength of the 'parents' (the Resource), the good fortune is likewise abundant; one must travel into an Officer-star luck-period to flourish, or travel into a Resource (印綬) luck-period to flourish as well.
sentences.enNote: 父母 'the parents' = the Resource (印綬), figured as the parent that generates the self.

sentences.en: The 《诗诀》 *Shī Jué* (Verse Mnemonic): 'When the Month meets the Resource (印綬), it welcomes the Officer star; when the luck enters the Officer's territory, the fortune is surely pure and noble; when a Death-and-Extinction (死绝) luck-period reaches the self, it is unfavorable; and travelling a Wealth luck-period thereafter, of a hundred ventures none succeeds.'

For example, 甲 (Jiǎ) sees 丙 (Bǐng) as its Eating God (食神 shíshén), which can generate Earth as Wealth; yet 壬 Rén (yang Water) overcomes 丙 (Bǐng) Fire, so 丙 (Bǐng) Fire can no longer generate the Earth-Wealth of 甲 (Jiǎ) Wood — this is what is meant by 'when 甲 (Jiǎ) uses the Eating God, it greatly dreads seeing this [壬 Rén].'
If it also sees 庚 (Gēng) as the Seven Killings (七杀), it needs 丙 (Bǐng) and 丁 (Dīng) Fire to restrain it; [but then] it fears seeing Water, which on the contrary becomes a calamity!
乙 (Yǐ) takes 庚 (Gēng) as the husband; seeing 丙 (Bǐng) overcome 庚 (Gēng), it therefore harms the husband; in a man's chart it then harms the wife.
sentences.enNote: For a female 乙 Day Master, 庚 is the Direct Officer = the husband-star; 丙 is 乙's Hurting Officer, which overcomes 庚.

sentences.en: When the five yang [stems] meet the five yin [stems] of the same phase, it constitutes 'Ruined Wealth' (败财 bàicái); it chiefly harms the wife and injures the children.
sentences.enNote: 败财 (bàicái) is this text's term for a yang Day Master meeting its same-phase yin stem — the case standard Ziping counts as 劫财 Rob Wealth.

sentences.en: When the five yin [stems] meet the five yang [stems] of the same phase, it constitutes Rob Wealth (劫财 jiécái); it chiefly brings loss and squandering and calls for guarding against petty people, but it does not harm the wife.

[The Goat-Blade] favors the Indirect Officer, i.e. the Seven Killings (七杀), and favors the Resource (印綬); it dislikes Reversal (反吟 fǎnyín) and Reduplication (伏吟 fúyín), dislikes the 魁罡 Kuígāng pillars, and dislikes the Three Harmonies (三合 sānhé).
sentences.enNote: 偏官七杀 = the Indirect Officer, i.e. the Seven Killings (one and the same). The elided subject is the Goat-Blade (羊刃/阳刃 yángrèn), the topic of this chapter. 魁罡 (Kuígāng), not in the glossary, are the special day-pillars 庚辰/庚戌/壬辰/戊戌.

sentences.en: 甲 (Jiǎ), 丙 (Bǐng), 戊 Wù (yang Earth), 庚 (Gēng), and 壬 (Rén) — the five yang stems — have the Blade, while 乙 (Yǐ), 丁 (Dīng), 己 Jǐ (yin Earth), 辛 Xīn (yin Metal), and 癸 Guǐ (yin Water) — the five yin stems — have none; hence the name 阳刃 (yángrèn), the 'yang[-stem] Blade' — the star the site renders as the Goat-Blade (羊刃, a homophone of 阳刃).
sentences.enNote: The site/glossary single-source rendering of this star is the Goat-Blade (羊刃 yángrèn); this sentence keeps close to the source because its whole point is the yang-stem etymology of the written form 阳刃 (羊/阳 are homophones).

sentences.en: If the Goat-Blade (阳刃) is present in the chart, one may not straightaway call it ominous; it is broadly similar to the Seven Killings (七杀).
sentences.enNote: 阳刃 = the site's Goat-Blade (羊刃 yángrèn); the text writes the homophone 阳刃.

sentences.en: In general, one who has the Goat-Blade (阳刃) is mostly a person of wealth and rank, and it in fact favors the Indirect Wealth (偏财) and the Seven Killings (七杀).
sentences.enNote: 阳刃 = the site's Goat-Blade (羊刃 yángrèn); the text writes the homophone 阳刃.

sentences.en: '…When both the Goat-Blade (阳刃) and the Killings (七杀) are complete, this is not something an ordinary person possesses.'
sentences.enNote: The opening 』 marks this line as the close of a quotation carried over from the previous sentence. 阳刃 = the site's Goat-Blade (羊刃 yángrèn).

sentences.en: Thus the 《喜忌篇》 *Xǐjì Piān* (Essay on Preferences and Taboos) states: 'A 戊 Wù (yang Earth) day in a 午 Wǔ (Horse) month is not to be read as the Blade; if the Year and Hour have much Fire, it becomes instead the Resource (印綬).'
sentences.enNote: 《喜忌篇》 is not in the glossary bookTitles; title translated directly as a site rendering. 戊's Blade sits at 午, but 午 (Fire) generates 戊 (Earth), so it acts as the Resource.

sentences.en: The 《诗诀》 *Shī Jué* (Verse Mnemonic): 'When the Goat-Blade (阳刃) is present, do not read it as ominous; [yet] when the self is light, its returning aid instead turns ominous; one only dislikes the Year and Month pillars meeting it doubled; do not take the birth hour as a palace of wrath.'
sentences.enNote: 阳刃 = the site's Goat-Blade (羊刃 yángrèn). 身轻返助却为凶 is rendered per the received text; some editions read the weak-self case as favorable, so this line is textually contested. 怒宫 'palace of wrath' = treating the Hour pillar as the place where the Blade rages.

sentences.en: Taking the day-stem as the ruling self: the Direct Resource (正印 zhèngyìn) is the true mother; the Indirect Resource (偏印 piānyìn) is the step-mother and also the paternal grandfather; the Indirect Wealth (偏财 piāncái) is the father — being the mother's husband-star — and is also the secondary wife; the Direct Wealth (正财 zhèngcái) is the wife; the Indirect Wealth is the concubine, and is the father; the Companion (比肩 bǐjiān) is brothers and sisters; the Seven Killings (七杀) is the son; the Direct Officer (正官 zhèngguān) is the daughter; the Eating God (食神) is the grandson; the Hurting Officer (伤官 shāngguān) is the granddaughter and also the paternal grandmother.

In a woman's chart the reckoning of the six kinships (六亲 liùqīn) differs from a man's: it takes the Officer star as the husband-star; the Seven Killings (七杀) is the secondary husband; the Eating God (食神) is the son; the Hurting Officer (伤官) is the daughter.
The classic states: 'A man takes what conquers his day-stem as his heir; a woman takes what her day-stem generates as her children, and also as her servants.'
sentences.enNote: 剋干 'what conquers the stem' = the Officer and Killings; 干生 'what the stem generates' = the Eating God and Hurting Officer.

sentences.en: When the Resource (印綬) meets Wealth, it harms the mother and the grandmother; when the chart shows the Companion (比肩), Rob Wealth (劫财), or the Goat-Blade (阳刃), it harms the wife, the concubine, and the father; when Officers and Killings (官杀) are many, brothers are hard to have; when the Hurting Officer (伤官) and the Eating God (食神) are many, offspring are hard to have; the Indirect Resource (偏印) harms the grandson and overcomes the grandmother.
sentences.enNote: 见比劫阳刃 shares the elided subject-frame of 印綬见财: the case where 比劫 / 阳刃 appear in the chart. 比劫 = 比肩 + 劫财. 梟印 in the original = 偏印 (Indirect Resource); the colloquial 'owl' rendering is avoided in English per the glossary. 阳刃 = the site's Goat-Blade (羊刃).

sentences.en: When Metal (jīn) meets the void it rings, when Fire (huǒ) meets the void it flares, and when Water (shuǐ) meets the void it flows — for these three the void is highly auspicious; when Wood (mù) meets the void it rots and when Earth (tǔ) meets the void it crumbles, and these two indicate misfortune.
sentences.enNote: 空 here is 空亡 (also 旬空), the void or empty branches; the maxim states how each phase is judged when it falls on a void.

sentences.en: The 《六亲捷要歌》 *Liùqīn Jiéyào Gē* (Song of the Essentials of the Six Relations) holds: when the Emolument (lù) is divided it must harm the mistress of the household (the wife); when the Companion (bǐjiān) piles up layer on layer it injures the stern parent (the father); Direct Wealth (zhèngcái) overcomes the mother while Indirect Wealth (piāncái) stands for the father; and husband and wife punish one another when they meet the Retreating Spirit (tuìshén).
sentences.enNote: 主馈人 = the one who manages the household provisions, i.e. the wife; 严亲 = the stern parent, i.e. the father; 退神 (tuìshén, the 'Retreating Spirit') is a stem-branch term not in the glossary.

sentences.en: Direct Wealth (zhèngcái) stands for the proper wife, and Indirect Wealth (piāncái) for the concubine.
Should the chart further show a Yǐ-Wood formation — the branches Hài, Mǎo, and Wèi combining into a Wood frame — the wife is harmed.
sentences.enNote: 乙木局 = the Wood formation, namely the 亥卯未 Three Harmonies (sānhé) trine, which overcomes the Wealth (Earth) star standing for the wife.

sentences.en: A Jiǎ-Yín pillar overcomes the wife, and moreover indicates that the wife is not upright.
When the Wealth and Officer stars sit in the day and month branches, it indicates a wife of much inner support, and further that the husband gains wealth through his wife.
sentences.enNote: 日下/月下 = the day-branch and month-branch; 財官 = the Wealth (正/偏财) and Officer (正官 zhèngguān) stars.

sentences.en: For instance, when a Jiǎ Day Master (rìzhǔ) meets Gēng and Shēn, these are the sons; Xīn and Yǒu are the daughters.
sentences.enNote: For a Jiǎ (Wood) Day Master the Metal Officer/Killing stands for children: yang Metal (Gēng/Shēn) for sons, yin Metal (Xīn/Yǒu) for daughters.

sentences.en: When Wù and Jǐ Earth (tǔ) hold the seasonal command (dé lìng), the son is well-supported and of a compliant, harmonious nature.
sentences.enNote: 得令 = holding the month-command (月令 yuèlìng), i.e. being in season.

sentences.en: A yang day with a yang hour: sons appear again and again; a yang day with a yin hour: first a son, then a daughter; a yin day with a yin hour: daughters appear again and again; a yin day with a yang hour: first a daughter, then a son.
When the Hurting Officer (shāngguān) meets the Officer — the Direct Officer (zhèngguān) — the descendants are fierce and unruly.

In a woman's chart the Hurting Officer (shāngguān) is taken as the son and the Eating God (shíshén) as the daughter; if the Direct Resource (zhèngyìn) or the Indirect Resource (piānyìn) appears, offspring are hard to obtain.
sentences.enNote: 印绶 = the Direct Resource (正印); 枭神 is the colloquial name for the Indirect Resource (偏印), rendered per glossary rather than 'Owl Spirit'.

sentences.en: In the Eight Characters (bāzì), one Seven Killings (qīshā) means one son, two mean two sons, and no Seven Killings means no son.
